title: diag.2: radio — DIO1 interrupt timeout detector
description: After lora_send, if TX_DONE IRQ doesn't fire within 2x expected airtime: (1) try extending the timeout to 4x, (2) if still no IRQ, scan alternate DIO1 pin candidates from DTS compatible list, (3) report DIAG_RADIO_DIO1_ADAPT with the pin that worked or DIAG_RADIO_DIO1_FAIL if none did. Adapt: update the active IRQ pin at runtime. Report via /diag.
